texture: Coarse to medium textured, light to medium loamy
drainage: Well-drained to moderately well-drained
management_recommendations: Add Farm Yard Manure (FYM) or compost to improve water-retention in red sandy soils. Balanced split application of nitrogen is advised to avoid leaching.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & KSDA
source_document: Soils of Karnataka for Optimising Land Use, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Coarse sandy to gravelly loam, highly porous
drainage: Excessively to well-drained in uplands, poorly drained in low-lying coastal plains

general_fertility_status.available_phosphorus_status: Low (< 10 kg/ha due to aluminium/iron fixation)
general_fertility_status.available_potassium_status: Low (< 120 kg/ha due to high rainfall leaching)

management_recommendations: Liming or agricultural dolomite application is recommended to manage soil acidity based on soil test. Apply rock phosphate or single super phosphate for phosphorus availability.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Bengaluru
source_document: Soils of Karnataka Coastal Zone, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Clayey, fine-textured with high moisture-retention capacity
drainage: Moderately slow to imperfectly drained in heavy black soils
management_recommendations: Deep black soils require proper surface drainage to avoid waterlogging. Apply zinc sulphate and incorporate organic biomass to improve soil structure.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Dharwad
source_document: Soils of Karnataka for Optimising Land Use, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Medium textured sandy clay loam
drainage: Well-drained
management_recommendations: Organic manuring and green manuring (e.g. sunnhemp) enhance nutrient retention and biological activity.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Bengaluru
source_document: Soils of Eastern Dry Zone of Karnataka, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Medium textured, gravelly in ridges
drainage: Well-drained
management_recommendations: Test soil for micronutrients and heavy metals in peri-urban areas. Maintain organic matter inputs.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Bengaluru
source_document: Soils of Eastern Dry Zone of Karnataka, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Medium textured, sandy loam to clay loam
drainage: Well-drained to moderately well-drained
management_recommendations: Adopt integrated nutrient management (INM) combining chemical fertilizers with bio-fertilizers (Azospirillum, PSB).
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Bengaluru
source_document: Soils of Karnataka for Optimising Land Use, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Coarse to medium textured, gravelly
drainage: Well-drained to excessively drained in gravelly upland terrains
management_recommendations: Soil moisture conservation via mulching and contour bunding. Gypsum application is beneficial for groundnut peg development.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Bengaluru
source_document: Soils of Central Dry Zone of Karnataka, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Coarse to medium textured, prone to crusting
drainage: Well-drained
management_recommendations: Mulching reduces soil surface crusting and conserves drip irrigation water. Apply soluble calcium and boron for tomato and potato fruit development.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Bengaluru
source_document: Soils of Eastern Dry Zone of Karnataka, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Coarse to medium textured
drainage: Well-drained
management_recommendations: Adopt fertigation through drip irrigation to ensure targeted nutrient delivery in light soils.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Bengaluru
source_document: Soils of Eastern Dry Zone of Karnataka, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Medium textured, light loamy to gravelly clay
drainage: Well-drained
management_recommendations: Correct subsoil acidity with lime or dolomite in hilly taluks. Monitor for potato early/late blight associated with soil moisture.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Bengaluru
source_document: Soils of Southern Transition Zone of Karnataka, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Clayey to clay loam with high swelling/shrinking property
drainage: Moderately well-drained in transition ridges, slow in deep black flats
management_recommendations: Deep black soils require broad bed and furrow (BBF) systems for in-situ moisture conservation and excess water runoff control.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Dharwad
source_document: Soils of Northern Transition Zone of Karnataka, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Coarse to medium textured with high gravel content
drainage: Well-drained in uplands, poorly drained in coastal valleys
management_recommendations: Apply agricultural lime or dolomite at recommended soil-test rates to reduce aluminium toxicity and enhance phosphorus efficiency.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Bengaluru
source_document: Soils of Coastal Karnataka, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Gravelly loam to clay loam, rich in humus in forest fringe
drainage: Well-drained to excessively drained on slopes
management_recommendations: Terracing and vegetative cover prevent severe topsoil erosion during monsoon downpours.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Dharwad
source_document: Soils of Coastal and Hilly Zone of Karnataka, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Variable: light sandy loam in uplands to heavy clay in plains
drainage: Well-drained (red soils) to moderately slow (black soils)
management_recommendations: Drought-proofing through in-situ moisture conservation (compartmental bunding). Gypsum application supports groundnut production.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Bengaluru
source_document: Soils of Central Dry Zone of Karnataka, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Heavy clay in canal command / black soils, sandy loam in granite outcrops
drainage: Slow to imperfectly drained in heavy vertisols, susceptible to salinity under over-irrigation
management_recommendations: Avoid excessive canal irrigation to prevent waterlogging and secondary soil salinization. Foliar spray of FeSO4 is beneficial for iron chlorosis in alkaline soils.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Raichur
source_document: Soils of Northern Dry Zone of Karnataka, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Heavy clay (montmorillonitic), highly expansive
drainage: Slow to imperfectly drained
management_recommendations: Deep tillage during summer opens soil for aeration and monsoon infiltration. Soil application of zinc sulphate (25 kg/ha) is recommended based on soil test.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Raichur
source_document: Soils of North Eastern Dry Zone of Karnataka, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Clayey in valleys, shallow gravelly on plateaus
drainage: Slow in black clay soils, rapid in shallow gravelly plateaus
management_recommendations: Adopt drip irrigation and fertigation to prevent salinity hazards and maximize water use efficiency.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Dharwad
source_document: Soils of Northern Dry Zone of Karnataka, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Fine clay in Tungabhadra command, sandy loam in dry uplands
drainage: Moderately slow to slow in black soils
management_recommendations: Ensure proper drainage in paddy canal command areas to mitigate salinity and sodicity risks.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & UAS Raichur
source_document: Soils of North Eastern Dry Zone of Karnataka, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Medium to fine textured
drainage: Well-drained to moderately well-drained
management_recommendations: Apply lime/dolomite in acidic pockets based on soil testing. Efficient surface drainage in lowlands prevents paddy root rot during heavy rainfall.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & KSNUAHS Shivamogga
source_document: Soils of Karnataka Hilly and Transition Zones, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47

texture: Medium textured gravelly loam to clay loam
drainage: Well-drained to excessively drained on slopes

general_fertility_status.organic_carbon_status: High in hills (> 0.75%), Low in plains (0.35%)

management_recommendations: Soil conservation measures on slopes; application of organic compost and lime for acidic plantation soils.
source_authority: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Regional Centre Bengaluru & KSNUAHS Shivamogga
source_document: Soils of Chikkamagaluru District, ICAR-NBSS&LUP Publ. 47
